patronOf.pt-BR: A Cruz de Cristo entre as luzes

prayerExcerpt.en-US: We proclaim Christ crucified; Christ, the power of God and the wisdom of God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nós anunciamos Cristo crucificado, poder e sabedoria de Deus.

meta.basis: 'On or next to the altar are to be placed candlesticks with lighted candles: at least two in any celebration, or even four or six, especially for a Sunday Mass'; 'on the altar or close to it, there is to be a cross adorned with a figure of Christ crucified' (GIRM 117), 'clearly visible to the assembled people' and kept near the altar even outside celebrations (GIRM 308); the candlesticks stand on the altar or around it (GIRM 307); the altar cross deserves every care (GIRM 350). The card takes the Sunday six, on the altar, rising toward the cross, a traditional arrangement the norms allow. The excerpt is 1 Cor 1:23-24, the Communion Antiphon of Saint John Chrysostom (13 September), from the Common of Doctors.
